1. Original GMP forms are not retained. The routine practice across the site is to discard original GMP forms if there are mistakes or changes required after receiving feedback. The data from the discarded GMP forms is rewritten onto a new GMP form. This routine practice is not consistent with procedure SOP-GE1008 “Recording Data” which in section 8.1.7 prohibits destruction of original GMP forms. Employees can print forms used for GMP recording from the Doc Compliance system. Although this software maintains an audit trail of what GMP forms are printed, the audit trail is not reviewed and the GMP forms are not reconciled to ensure printed forms are retained.
